qa_pair.question: The project contains an animated launch sequence with on-screen messages. What exact message is shown on screen two and a half seconds into the main composition? Answer with the text exactly as displayed.
In the main composition, how many seconds pass between the moment the final countdown number appears and the moment the vehicle starts moving off the pad? Answer with a number of seconds only.
The streak left behind the ascending vehicle does not have its own keyframes; its length is computed from another layer. What is the name of that other layer?
Ignoring any shake or wobble, what vertical (y) coordinate does the vehicle's motion path end at, in composition pixels? Answer with the number only.
The vehicle is drawn as a single vector layer built from several separate shape groups (body, details and so on). How many top-level shape groups does that layer contain? Answer with a number.
Each time the on-screen countdown changes, the message briefly pops in larger and settles to normal size. At what scale percentage does each pop start? Answer with the number only.
An orange light flares on the ground when the engine fires. How many seconds pass between its first opacity keyframe and its last one? Answer with a number of seconds only.
The main composition has a control layer that shakes several other layers through parenting. How many layers in the main composition are children of that control layer? Answer with a number.
The ground flare's soft edge comes from a mask rather than a blur effect. How many pixels of feather does that mask use? Answer with a single number.

The layer that draws the field of stars is composited onto the sky with a non-default layer blend mode. Which blend mode is it? Answer with After Effects' BlendingMode name in uppercase, for example NORMAL or SCREEN.
